n_requests: <int> Number of transportation requests, each requiring pickup at one location and delivery to another.
n_nodes: <int> Total number of nodes in the network, equal to 2 * n_requests + 2 (pickups, deliveries, and two depot copies).
vehicle_capacity: <int> Maximum carrying capacity of each identical vehicle.
planning_horizon: <list[int], length 2> Earliest and latest times defining the operational planning window.
vehicle_fixed_cost: <int> Fixed cost incurred for each vehicle used, added to arcs leaving the origin depot.

nodes.node_id: <int> Unique identifier for this node in the network.
nodes.request_id: <int or null> Identifier of the transportation request this node belongs to, or null for depot nodes.
nodes.x: <int> Horizontal geographic coordinate of the node.
nodes.y: <int> Vertical geographic coordinate of the node.
nodes.load: <int> Quantity of goods picked up (positive) or delivered (negative) at this node, zero at depots.
nodes.service_time: <int> Duration of the service operation performed at this node.
nodes.tw_early: <int> Earliest time at which service may begin at this node.
nodes.tw_late: <int> Latest time at which service may begin at this node.

n_arcs: <int> Total number of directed arcs in the network.

arcs.from: <int> Node identifier where this arc originates.
arcs.to: <int> Node identifier where this arc terminates.
arcs.cost: <float> Travel cost of traversing this arc, including the vehicle fixed cost for arcs leaving the origin depot.
arcs.travel_time: <float> Travel time required to traverse this arc.
